Subject: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — next steps

Thanks for a productive call today — quick recap and next steps (MAP draft attached).

High-level target: mutual goal to get procurement signed and first month of Dedicated capacity by 2026-03-15. Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
- Milestone 1 (Security review): Redwood delivers SOC 2 package (questionnaire + evidence list) by 2026-02-24 — responsibility: Redwood (Marissa + Dev team).
- Milestone 2 (Security sign-off): Aurelia completes review and provides feedback by 2026-03-01 — responsibility: Aurelia security (Alex).
- Milestone 3 (Procurement & Legal): Finalize contract redlines and PO by 2026-03-10 — responsibility: Aurelia procurement (Sara) + Redwood legal (Rachel).
- Milestone 4 (Pilot/POC start): Dedicated capacity provisioned & pilot kickoff by 2026-03-15 — responsibility: Redwood ops.

Dependencies:
- SOC 2 artifacts (see requested evidence list in MAP milestone)
- NDA/PSA redlines from legal (we can accept standard redlines, track via HubSpot/DocuSign)
- Procurement PO to enable provisioning

Action items / Next steps:
1) I will deliver the MAP draft (attached) and the SOC2 questionnaire/evidence package.
2) Alex — confirm who on your side should receive the SOC2 package and whether redaction is required for any items.
3) Sara — confirm procurement timeline / PO approver.

Attachment: MAP-draft-AureliaTech-v1.docx (draft MAP with milestones and responsibilities).

Thanks — I’ll follow up after we confirm the SOC2 delivery channel.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Alex Sanders <alex.sanders@aureliatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — next steps

Thanks Marissa — the MAP looks good. A couple quick asks on the SOC 2 package: 

- Can you send the SOC 2 Type II report, system description, and a control-evidence checklist (we prefer a simple mapping CSV or spreadsheet)?
- If there are items that need redaction (customer IP in logs, specific account IDs), can you indicate which files are redacted and provide an unredacted version under NDA if required?
- Any bridge letters, pen-test summaries, or subprocessor attestations would be helpful.

Who should we expect the package from and what’s the ETA? We’d like to schedule a 30-min security sync after we review (proposed week of Mar 1).

—Alex
Alex Sanders
Head of Security | Aurelia Tech
alex.sanders@aureliatech.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 11:00:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — assemble artifacts

Forwarding Alex’s request — can you assemble the SOC 2 package for Aurelia (deadline: EOD 2026-02-24). Items requested by the customer:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- System description (high-level, with list of boundaries)
- Control evidence list (CSV preferred; map controls to artifacts)
- Questionnaire (we should provide the filled Excel template)
- Pen-test summary / scope (if redacted, note location)
- Subprocessor list and any third-party attestations
- Sample logs retention policy / data encryption descriptions

Packaging notes: Create a single zip (Redwood_SOC2_Package_v1.zip) with clearly named files and a README that lists any redactions or items withheld pending NDA. We’ll provide a secure S3 link to Aurelia rather than email attachments.

Dev — can you confirm what we can share publicly and what needs redaction? Rachel — loop in legal if we need a bridge letter or extra NDA.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:45:00 +0000

- SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf (redacted: internal account identifiers removed)
- System_Description.pdf

I’ll upload the zip to a secure link and share by EOD 2026-02-23. All redactions will be documented in README.txt inside the zip.

Attachments (to be included in package): SOC2-questionnaire-AureliaTech.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_Package_v1.zip (will contain files listed above).

—Dev
